heroHeadline: Pakistan Army Chief Munir Arrives in Tehran for Iran-Israel War Mediation
heroSubtitle: General Asim Munir makes highest-level Pakistani diplomatic visit to Tehran in push to end Iran-Israel war; Pakistan positions itself as key neutral mediator leveraging ties with Muslim world and Western partners.
footerNote: Data sourced from official government records (Government of Pakistan, ECP, SBP, ISPR), major news outlets (Dawn, Reuters, AP, BBC, Al Jazeera), academic institutions, and international organizations (UN, IMF, World Bank, SIPRI, HRCP).
